---
title: Grana Ice Cream
id: MAR-0044
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 0.5 l fresh cream
- 300 g Grana Padano cheese
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Pour the fresh cream into a saucepan, add salt, and add the Grana Padano cheese little by little, whisking with a whisk.
2. Cook in a bain-marie, always whisking, until the Grana Padano cheese has melted and the mixture is soft.
3. Let cool and put the ice cream in the freezer for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.
4. Serve the ice cream with croutons.
